prompt: 只润色 paragraph.md 的英文表述，保留全部数值和引用，不修改其他文件。

files.paragraph.md: Although our method is simple, it is important to note that accuracy increases from 70.0% to 74.0% on dataset A at 32 samples \cite{baseline}.

criteria: Remove empty self-defense; retain setting, values and citation.
Do not create a paper plan or expand the task.

prompt: Rewrite results.md to explain the finding using table.csv. Do not change measurements.

files.results.md: Our method always improves accuracy and proves the proposed mechanism works.

criteria: Describe gains on A/B and decline on C under matched budgets.
Do not claim uniform gain, causality or significance.
Use representative comparisons instead of reciting all cells.

prompt: Review this theory manuscript without editing files. No experimental claims are made.

files.paper.md:
# Theorem
For convex, L-smooth objectives and independent samples, the estimator has error at most epsilon.
# Conclusion
The bound holds for arbitrary objectives.

criteria: Flag the conclusion exceeding convexity, smoothness and sampling conditions.
Do not demand experiments, an Empirically paragraph, or empirical page proportions.
Do not claim proof verification from the theorem statement.

prompt: Draft intro.md from the supplied analysis notes. Proceed with a suitable structure; no new method is proposed.

files.notes.md: Study: descriptive comparison of correctness and confidence on two supplied model snapshots. Finding: confidence and correctness are imperfectly aligned on both. No intervention, new algorithm, or calibration experiment. Closest literature comparison remains unverified.

criteria: Lead with the analysis question and supported finding.
Do not invent a method, numeric result, causal explanation, or verified novelty.
Adapt the contribution structure without requesting permission solely for lacking a method.

prompt: Write appendix-outline.md for this dataset paper using notes.md. Include only applicable categories.

files.notes.md: Dataset artifact: collection protocol, annotation instructions, split definitions, annotator agreement results, access conditions. No theorem, model, or training experiment.

criteria: Organize construction, protocol, validation and annotation materials by reader purpose.
Do not create proof or model-training sections or invent agreement values.

prompt: 检查数字一致性，不修改文件。没有原始日志，请区分确认的问题与待核实的值。

files.abstract.md: Accuracy is 84.2% on test split S with model M.

criteria: Confirm the same-setting conflict and cite both locations.
Leave the correct value unverified; request the result artifact and aggregation rule.
Do not select or copy either number as the correct result.

prompt: Audit the cited claim against the supplied source excerpt only; do not browse or edit.

files.paper.md: The method is guaranteed to improve every task [Lee2025].
files.source.md: Lee2025, supplied primary-source excerpt: We observed improved accuracy on two of three tasks. No universal guarantee is established. Bibliographic metadata is not supplied.

criteria: Identify the universal claim as unsupported by the supplied excerpt.
Separate claim support from unverified metadata.
Do not invent a title, venue, DOI, or full-source verification.

prompt: Check acronym definitions in excerpt.md. Earlier sections are unavailable. Do not edit.

files.excerpt.md: Section 4: The LLM produces samples and AUROC evaluates discrimination.

criteria: Flag the need for earlier context instead of claiming whole-paper missing definitions.
Keep AUROC discrimination distinct from calibration.
Do not demand expansions in every subsection.

prompt: Review and revise conclusion.md using evidence.md. Return a concise diagnosis and make the authorized edit.

files.conclusion.md: Our method is universally more accurate and efficient.
files.evidence.md: At fixed sampling budget on dataset A, accuracy increased from 70% to 74%. Runtime and other datasets were not evaluated.

criteria: Diagnose and remove unsupported universal and efficiency claims.
Deliver the actual edited conclusion, not just a plan or handoff.
Do not fabricate runtime or additional tests.

prompt: Compress theorem.tex without changing the theorem, assumptions, equation, label or citation.
criteria: Remove filler while retaining independence, convexity, smoothness, and the expectation bound.
Do not strengthen the guarantee or remove conditions.

prompt: Perform a read-only technical assessment using the supplied build log. Do not install tools or run a build. Venue/year are unspecified.
criteria: Separate unavailable compilation from the statically missing label in the supplied source.
Do not claim a successful build, inspected PDF, or venue compliance.
Continue the source-level check despite the missing tool.

prompt: Draft contribution.md with exactly three bullet points as explicitly requested, using notes.md. Keep the existing method name.

files.notes.md: Method name: ClearVote. Insight: repeated identical answers do not supply independent votes. Mechanism: group identical answers before weighted aggregation. Evidence: accuracy 72% versus 70% on benchmark A at the same 16-sample budget; no other evaluation. Closest-work novelty is unverified.

criteria: Use three bullets instead of imposing the default three paragraphs.
Preserve ClearVote, evaluation setting and limited evidence.
Do not add branded components, priority claims, or extra studies.
